checks.test: const links = $$('nav a'); const cur = links.filter((a) => a.hasAttribute('aria-current')); return cur.length === 1 && cur[0].textContent.trim() === 'Tickets' && cur[0].getAttribute('aria-current') === 'page';

const fav = $('#fav'); if (fav.tagName !== 'BUTTON' || fav.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'false') return false; await click(fav); const on = fav.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'; await click(fav); return on && fav.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'false' && fav.textContent.trim() === 'Save to wishlist';

const s = $('#basket-status'); const role = s.getAttribute('role'); const live = s.getAttribute('aria-live'); const isLive = role === 'status' || role === 'alert' || live === 'polite' || live === 'assertive'; if (!isLive) return false; await click('#add'); return /tickets? in your basket/.test(s.textContent);

const focusable = $$('a[href], button, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]').filter((el) => el.tabIndex >= 0 && !el.inert && !el.closest('[inert]')); return focusable.every((el) => !el.closest('[aria-hidden="true"]')) && $$('button').length >= 3;
